available_to: ALL
description: Share verified indicators, affected systems, and status with other teams. Free and always available — in a cyber phase it is also the only way anyone learns what is spreading before it reaches them.

available_to: Shentel Communications;Virginia Tech Division of IT
description: Sever the shared connection between the university research network and the clinical VLANs, and verify no lateral path remains. Stops the spread; also cuts the research traffic and any clinic still riding that path.

available_to: Carilion Clinic Information Security;Carilion Rural Clinic Network
description: Take the electronic health record offline in the affected facilities and stand the documented downtime protocol up in its place. Care continues on paper; the record stops being a route for the malware.

available_to: Carilion Clinic Information Security;VA Department of Health SW District
description: Pull infusion pumps, imaging and monitoring off the network onto isolated operation, device by device, with a clinician at each one. Nothing is unplugged from a patient; everything is unplugged from the network.

available_to: Carilion Rural Clinic Network
description: Bring in the extra clinical and clerical staff a paper clinic needs — scribes, runners, a second triage line — so six rural sites keep seeing patients at a fraction of normal throughput instead of closing.

available_to: CISA Regional Coordinator;Virginia Tech Division of IT
description: Pull memory and network telemetry from an infected host and characterise what this is: how it evades detection, what it looks for, and whether it is still changing. Nothing else is knowable until this is done.

available_to: FBI Richmond Cyber Task Force;CISA Regional Coordinator
description: Image the compromised hosts before they are rebuilt, with chain of custody intact. A case survives; the systems imaged stay down for the duration, which is time a clinic does not have.

available_to: CISA Regional Coordinator;VITA Commonwealth CIO
description: Push the indicators of compromise to every regional partner and to the state's shared services, so the organisations not yet hit can look for it themselves.

available_to: VITA Commonwealth CIO
description: Cut the region's connections to the Commonwealth's shared services. The state's systems stop being reachable from an infected region — and so do the services the region's county governments run on.

available_to: Food City Pharmacy Systems;VA Department of Health SW District
description: Authorise dispensing against a written protocol and a signed log while prescription verification is down: what may be filled, what may not, and how many days' supply a pharmacist may release without a check.

available_to: Food City Pharmacy Systems;Carilion Rural Clinic Network
description: Stand up a staffed voice line between the pharmacy counters and the clinics so a prescription can be confirmed by a human when the system that would confirm it is offline.

available_to: Appalachian Faith & Community Network;VA Department of Health SW District
description: Reach the patients whose care cannot wait for a records system — dialysis, oxygen, refrigerated medication — by phone, by church list, and door to door where there is no signal.

available_to: Governor's SW Virginia Liaison;VA Department of Health SW District
description: Say plainly what is affected, what care is still safe to seek, and what is not yet known. A joint statement from the state and public health; the number in it has to come from a team that verified it.

available_to: Governor's SW Virginia Liaison;SW Virginia EMA
requires_approval: Governor's SW Virginia Liaison or SW Virginia EMA
description: Push instructions over the emergency alert system to households with no internet and no cell service. It reaches everyone; it also cannot be taken back or corrected quietly.

available_to: SW Virginia EMA;VITA Commonwealth CIO
description: Move county government functions — permits, benefits, dispatch records — onto the continuity environment so a county does not stop operating while its shared services are cut.

available_to: Governor's SW Virginia Liaison;CISA Regional Coordinator
requires_approval: Governor's SW Virginia Liaison + CISA Regional Coordinator
description: Request a federal cyber emergency declaration and the national response that comes with it. It brings resources the region does not have, and it makes the region's incident a national story.

available_to: Virginia Tech Division of IT
description: Take the research data center down cold. The malware loses the host it entered on; ongoing research computation loses whatever was not checkpointed, and the faculty who own it were not asked.

available_to: Governor's SW Virginia Liaison
description: Open the state emergency procurement vehicle and underwrite up to $50K of another team's action. The only way a team with the authority and no budget acts this phase.

available_to: Governor's SW Virginia Liaison
description: Collect status from every team holding an incident, reconcile it into one regional picture, and file it. Richmond gets one number and one answer instead of twelve.

action_name: Clinic Link Restoration on a Clean Path
available_to: Shentel Communications;Carilion Rural Clinic Network
description: Rebuild the rural clinic links on a separately routed, freshly keyed path, verified clean before any clinic is reconnected. Records come back; anything still infected comes back with them if the verification was rushed.

available_to: FBI Richmond Cyber Task Force;CISA Regional Coordinator
description: Tell the region what is known about who is behind this and what they are after, at the level the investigation can bear. What partners can act on, without what a defence attorney could use.

available_to: Appalachian Faith & Community Network;SW Virginia EMA
description: Stand up the congregations, volunteer fire departments and community centres as the channel official information travels through, in a phase where the official channels are the ones nobody trusts.
